CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2465 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 345cdf5866c2f03cf3ae764c2aa4bd1b18d70184. Bus nonce: bdfeff3d9d24d549523dba7670d8d9b9. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 345cdf5866c2f03cf3ae764c2aa4bd1b18d70184`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 345cdf5866c2f03cf3ae764c2aa4bd1b18d70184` or `Fix review: blocked 345cdf5866c2f03cf3ae764c2aa4bd1b18d70184 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: bdfeff3d9d24d549523dba7670d8d9b9`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2465 345cdf5866c2f03cf3ae764c2aa4bd1b18d70184") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2465-bdfeff3d`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Production fix for the v7.0.1 owner report: cheap hours with comfort headroom are planned at a 25 C flow set-point instead of boosting. Owner bindings (tvofi 2026-10-19): heat aggressively in cheap windows; avoid suboptimal plans on every install type; the fix must not depend on a heat sensor; write only whole-integer set-points using the entity's step (default 1).
(A) modulation_floor_flow_c lifts from max(inlet, gate) (_gate_c is the single source), so a heating step at the floor never writes the same value as "off". Check the base 63/155 vs head 0/155 collision grid.
(B) The draw window stores each sample's written set-point and ceiling; max-end evidence comes only from ceiling-written or uncommanded samples; idle draw is learned from gate-held intervals and readings up to 1.25x idle are excluded; old uncommanded records are dropped by the first commanded sample. Check that the probe-shaped window learns 3.0 kW and the base learns a false 2.03 kW.
(C) inputs.write_setpoint quantises to the entity step in its own unit (floor rounds up; gate and ceiling round down; levels between round to nearest, in order), integer when whole; the smart_write valve rounds down. Four features checks changed expectations to whole degrees (named in the body); confirm each is correct, not weakened.
The decision logic was moved from flow_command(coord) to _flow_command(inp, state) so coord_footprint stays 2498. Re-run tools/audit/archscore/vector.py at base and head.
Controls to verify: 32 plans byte-identical base vs head (16 synthetic installs x spread/flat); flat-price null; hand mutants M1-M14 red, M0 68 checks green (dev/audit/harnesses/r10_setpoint_boost.py). 59 unpinned sites are left for mutation-autofix. Adversarially check that the Fahrenheit rounding and the 0.5/0.1-step entities are preserved, that the quantiser cannot push a write outside the entity min/max, and that (B) cannot starve the window of evidence on a pump that never reaches its ceiling. The owner's diagnostics export is private: never request it or build fixtures from it.
